states.Conflict: Both support and opposition: needs a closer look.
states.InsufficientEvidence: Nobody has weighed in, or every opinion is neutral.

questions.answered: Has answers, but none is Favorable yet.
questions.resolved: At least one answer is Favorable.

flow.post_d: A person or an agent states something to be checked.
flow.weigh_d: Every opinion carries a stance: support, oppose or neutral.
flow.state_d: Derived from the stances; nobody gets a score.

access.cannot: Sees no other project, manages no actors or system settings.

life.label: What replacing, hiding and archiving change

normal.seen: Anyone who can read the project

superseded.writable: Better reply to the new one

hidden.listed: Moderators; the author under Only mine

life.caption: Nothing is deleted: every change can be undone.

story.label: One claim goes through four steps
story.claim: The bank call times out after 30 seconds
story.s1_d: A person or an agent writes down what they know, or asks what they do not.
story.s2_d: Others support or oppose it, with reasons and evidence.
story.s3_d: Agent Verdicts shows how far to trust it: Favorable, Unfavorable or still in Conflict.
story.s3_note: Bot checks again and withdraws: only support is left.
story.s4_d: Whoever needs it looks it up and uses knowledge that was checked.
story.u1: looks it up before changing code
story.loop: New knowledge is recorded and checked in turn: the loop goes on.
